title: Design System: VAIF Agency Landing Page

display.purpose: Section headings and hero title. Cormorant Garamond for editorial authority.

title.purpose: Value card and service card headings. Smaller serif for contained authority.

body.purpose: All paragraph, description, and benefit-list text. Montserrat at 1.1rem minimum for legibility.

label.purpose: Form labels, section tags, nav links, stat footers. Tiny but weighty uppercase Montserrat.

shadows.name: button-lift
shadows.purpose: Primary CTA hover state — gold-tinted lift.

shadows.name: button-outline-lift
shadows.purpose: Secondary/ghost button hover — subtler gold glow.

shadows.name: phone-ambient
shadows.purpose: Hero phone mockup — heavy anchoring shadow.

shadows.name: dashboard-ambient
shadows.purpose: Permanent ambient depth for dashboard/teaser widgets.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default transition easing for hover and focus states.

motion.name: ease-entry
motion.purpose: Fade-in-up scroll reveal — decelerating, elegant entrance.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid gold CTA. Full-width in forms, auto-width in hero. The page's only filled button.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 16px 32px; background-color: #D4B04C; color: #000; border: none; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #E5C35E; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 6px 25px rgba(212, 176, 76, 0.3); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost outline CTA. Used alongside primary or as standalone secondary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 16px 32px; background: transparent; border: 2px solid #D4B04C; color: #D4B04C; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 4px; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(212, 176, 76, 0.15); }

components.name: Nav Highlight Button
components.description: Compact nav CTA. Outline at rest, inverts to filled gold on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 20px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #D4B04C; color: #D4B04C; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 4px; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-nav-btn:hover { background: #D4B04C; color: #000; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(212, 176, 76, 0.25); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Dark form field with gold focus ring. Accommodates inline prefix (R$, @).
components.css: .ds-input-group { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; } .ds-input-prefix { position: absolute; left: 20px; color: #D4B04C; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; z-index: 1; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 16px 20px 16px 50px; background-color: #1A1A1A; border: 1px solid #333; color: rgb(242, 237, 228); font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; font-size: 15px; border-radius: 4px; transition: border-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #555; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #D4B04C; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #D4B04C; } .ds-input--no-prefix { padding-left: 20px; } .ds-input--invalid { border-color: #D44C4C !important; }

components.name: Value Card
components.description: Three-column value proposition card with icon, title, description, and stat callout.
components.html:
Funil de Alto Padrão

Um sistema que atrai, qualifica e fecha clientes com orçamento acima de R$ 3.000.

2,4xTicket Médio
components.css: .ds-value-card { background: #121212; border: 1px solid #222222; padding: 60px 40px; text-align: center; transition: all 0.4s ease; position: relative; overflow: hidden; } .ds-value-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #D4B04C, transparent); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.4s ease; } .ds-value-card:hover { border-color: rgba(212, 176, 76, 0.3); transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-value-card:hover::before { opacity: 1; } .ds-value-icon { width: 56px; height: 56px; margin: 0 auto 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(212, 176, 76, 0.25); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-value-card h3 { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: 1.4rem; margin-bottom: 16px; color: rgb(242, 237, 228); } .ds-value-card p { font-size: 15px; color: #CCCCCC; line-height: 1.7; } .ds-value-stat { margin-top: 24px; padding-top: 24px; border-top: 1px solid #222222; } .ds-value-stat strong { color: #D4B04C; font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: 1.8rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-value-stat span { display: block; font-size: 10px; color: #CCCCCC; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; margin-top: 4px; }

components.name: Section Tag
components.description: Golden eyebrow label that precedes every section heading.
components.css: .ds-section-tag { display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #D4B04C; margin-bottom: 16px; font-family: 'Montserrat', sans-serif; }

components.name: Diamond Divider
components.description: Horizontal separator with rotating diamond — the system's signature mark.
components.css: .ds-diamond-divider { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px; margin: 24px 0; } .ds-diamond-line { width: 40px; height: 1px; background: #222222; } .ds-diamond { width: 6px; height: 6px; background: #D4B04C; transform: rotate(45deg); flex-shrink: 0; }

narrative.overview:
The Golden Needle is a precision instrument — deliberate, sharp, and irreplaceable. Like the tattoo machine it evokes, every element in this system earns its place. The design speaks to artists who already understand craft: nothing is decorative, everything is engineered. The gold (#D4B04C) is old-world bullion — muted, aged, earned — not jewelry-store glitter. It signals wealth that was built, not bought.

The atmosphere is refined, urgent, and aspirational. The page wastes no time on pleasantries; it confronts the artist with their hidden loss, then offers a precise instrument to recover it. The dark canvas (#0A0A0A) recedes, letting the gold do the talking. White space is generous; density is low; every section earns its scroll depth. Anti-references: no startup SaaS gradients, no neon aggression, no rounded blob illustrations, no emoji cheer.
keyCharacteristics: Gold-on-black palette with old-world bullion character — muted, earned, never garish
Cormorant Garamond for display authority paired with Montserrat for utilitarian precision
Low-density layout with 6rem section breathing room
Fade-in-up scroll animations with staggered delays — reveals feel earned, not auto-played
Diamond motif (◆) as the recurring brand mark — the needle's tip in geometric form
Card surfaces lift on hover with subtle shadow — layered, not flat

rules.name: The Bullion Rule
rules.body: Gold is used on ≤10% of any given screen. Its power comes from restraint. A page where everything is gold is a page where nothing is.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Red and green are functional, not decorative. They appear only in error and success states respectively; they are never used to "add color" to a section.

rules.name: The Two-Font Rule
rules.body: Never introduce a third font family. Cormorant and Montserrat cover every role. Icons are inline SVG — no icon fonts.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only on hover, on permanently elevated dashboard elements, or as ambient anchoring on the phone mockup. A card without an interactive surface gets no shadow.

dos: Do use gold sparingly — on exactly one CTA per viewport fold, on the diamond divider, and as the italic highlight in section headings. Gold is the precious metal; treat it like one.
Do maintain 6rem section padding on desktop and 4rem on mobile. Generous whitespace is the luxury signal.
Do pair Cormorant headings with Montserrat body in every text block. The pairing is the system's voice — breaking it reads as off-brand.
Do use fade-in-up animations with staggered delays (delay-1: 0.2s, delay-2: 0.4s, delay-3: 0.6s) on section entrance. The reveal must feel earned.
Do keep cards sharp-edged (no radius). Rounded corners are reserved for contained widget shells where 8px-16px radius signals a frame-within-frame relationship.
Do lift interactive surfaces on hover with translateY(-2px to -4px) and a gold-tinted box-shadow. Depth is earned by interaction.
donts: Don't introduce a third font family. Cormorant Garamond and Montserrat cover every typographic role.
Don't use red or green for decoration. --accent-red and --accent-green are functional signals — error and success only.
Don't add a border-radius to primary buttons, cards, or the qualifying form. Square shoulders are the system's posture.
Don't use drop shadows on static cards. Shadows are a hover response or a permanent ambient anchor for elevated widgets — never a default.
Don't use emoji, rounded blob illustrations, neon colors, or glitch animations. This is an atelier, not a nightclub or a SaaS dashboard.
Don't reduce body text below 1.1rem. The audience reads on phones between tattoo sessions — prioritize legibility over fitting more copy.
